value.message: Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre runs Parent and Tot for 18 months to 3.11, fall session Sept 12 to Dec 18, Saturday mornings - their site says, and registration opened July 20. They also run a Tues/Thurs 9:30-12 drop-in for under 4s, $15 per parent - their site says, though I could not confirm this year's dates. I'll keep watching and text you if I find more.
